owner_creation.analysis: anchor: The static ifile sentinel owns no heap names initially and its next/prev links point back to itself; allocated nodes form a circular list around it.
owner_creation.invariant: The sentinel is permanent image storage, not a node allocation.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

aliases_escapes.analysis: anchor: Navigation and link/unlink retain raw sentinel/node links; callers receive allocated node addresses that may be invalidated by deletion elsewhere.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Sentinel traversal cannot validate a retained node handle.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

callback_targets.analysis: anchor: Node creation calls mark_check_ifile after linking and deletion calls unmark before disposal; these direct cross-owner calls share the same list mutation interval.
callback_targets.invariant: Related mark callbacks must see a coherent list.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

invalidation.analysis: anchor: unlink updates neighboring links and later frees the node; the sentinel remains live, but no generation prevents a stale external node address from being reused.
invalidation.invariant: Permanent sentinel lifetime does not protect deleted nodes.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

mutation_commit.analysis: anchor: link_ifile publishes four raw links before index/count updates; no guard prevents observation or interruption of that intermediate state.
mutation_commit.invariant: List and index publication is not an atomic commit.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

release_pair.analysis: anchor: The sentinel must never be passed to free; only separately allocated nodes and their strings are released by del_ifile.
release_pair.invariant: Heap-node cleanup excludes the static anchor.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

error_cleanup.analysis: anchor: Allocation before linking leaves sentinel links unchanged, but later fatal paths can enter cleanup amid node or filename ownership changes.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error traversal still relies on raw list coherence.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.

signals_handoff.analysis: anchor: List writes are not masked or dispatched via a single owning event loop; the broad mutable-core owner finding stays attached.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 remains open for sentinel-linked ownership.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.
